etym.s: [स्थू STHŪ, be thick or strong, in sthaviman, 🞄sthavira, sthūṇā, sthūra, sthūla]

spans.s: sthū-rá, a. thick, broad, heavy, large, 🞄great (RV.).

sthū-rí, a. drawn by one animal, one-sided 🞄(V.);
 n. waggon drawn by one animal (V.).
sthūr-ikā, f. barren cow (? Manu VIII, 325).

sthūla‿antra, n. large intestine, 🞄straight-gut;
 -asthūla, a. large and not 🞄large: -tara, cpv. very large and small.

sthūla‿iccha, a. having immoderate 🞄wishes;
 -uccaya, m. middle pace in elephants.
